name: university-course-registration.catalog.search
description: Search this term's course catalog. Returns each matching course with all of its sections: meeting times, capacity, seats taken by enrolled students, seats held by pending waitlist offers, seats available, credits and prerequisite course codes. A course that requires a lab must be taken as one lecture plus one lab. Filters are optional and combine with AND. Read only.

term_id.description: Term to search. Optional: this portal serves a single term.

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against the course code, title and department.

department.description: Exact department name, case-insensitive, for example "Mathematics".

days.description: Keep only courses that can be taken entirely on these days: at least one complete lecture/lab bundle meets on no other day.

open_only.description: When true, keep only courses with at least one complete lecture/lab bundle in which every section has a seat available. A free lecture whose only labs are full does not count.

held.description: Seats reserved by pending waitlist offers; not enrollments, and not available to anyone else until released.

version.description: Increases each time this section's meeting times change.

linked_lecture_ids.description: Present on a lab that can only be combined with these lecture sections. Absent: any lecture of the course.

name: university-course-registration.course.get
description: Read one course: its sections with seats, which lecture/lab combinations form a valid bundle and whether each is currently available, the prerequisite courses and whether the signed-in student has completed each, the registration window and whether it is open now, and the student's current enrollment in the course if any. Read only.

id.description: The course ID, for example the id returned by catalog.search (not the course code).

held.description: Seats reserved by pending waitlist offers; not enrollments, and not available to anyone else until released.

version.description: Increases each time this section's meeting times change.

linked_lecture_ids.description: Present on a lab that can only be combined with these lecture sections. Absent: any lecture of the course.

completed.description: Whether the student's academic record lists this course as completed.

closes_at.description: Registration is closed at and after this instant.

open.description: Whether registration for this course is open at the current time.

available.description: True when every section of this lecture/lab combination has a seat available.

enrollment_id.description: The student's current enrollment in this course, or null.

name: university-course-registration.record.get
description: Read the signed-in student's academic record and the rules that apply: completed courses, enrolled credits and the credit limit, the term's registration window, the withdrawal deadline and whether an enrollment can still be given up now, and the enrollment policy (queue order, offer window, expiry boundary, swap and conflict rules). The record cannot be changed through this App. Read only.

enrolled.description: Credits of all currently enrolled courses. Waitlist entries and offers do not count.

limit.description: The student's credit limit for the term.

deadline.description: An enrollment cannot be given up, by withdrawing or by swapping out of it, at or after this instant.

open.description: Whether an enrollment can still be given up at the current time.

name: university-course-registration.schedule.get
description: Read the signed-in student's current schedule: each enrollment with its sections and meeting times, enrolled credits, every pair of sections whose meeting times overlap and the meeting-time change that caused it when there was one, and pending swaps waiting for a seat. Waitlist entries and offers are not enrollments and are not part of the schedule. Read only.

enrolled.description: Credits of all currently enrolled courses. Waitlist entries and offers do not count.

limit.description: The student's credit limit for the term.

caused_by.description: The meeting-time change that produced this overlap, or null when the overlap does not come from such a change.

name: university-course-registration.waitlist.list
description: Read the signed-in student's own waitlist entries and seat offers. Each entry shows its rank among entries waiting for the same seats, the sections it is still waiting for, and any rule that currently blocks it from receiving or accepting an offer. Each offer shows when it expires. A waitlist position or an offer is not an enrollment. Other students' entries are not shown. Read only.

swap_from_enrollment_id.description: The enrollment this entry would replace when it is a pending swap; otherwise null.

rank.description: 1 means no earlier entry is waiting for any of the same seats.

waiting_for_section_ids.description: Sections of the bundle that have no seat for this entry right now.

code.description: not_found, invalid_state, offer_not_live, offer_expired, invalid_bundle, withdrawal_closed, registration_closed, swap_required, pending_swap_exists, duplicate_enrollment, prerequisite_missing, seats_available, section_full, credit_limit_exceeded or time_conflict.

offer_id.description: With section_full: the student's own live offer that is holding a seat in one of the full sections. Accept that offer to use the seat.

blocked_by.description: Rules other than seat availability that this entry fails right now. A blocked entry keeps its place but holds no seat.

expires_at.description: The offer can be accepted or declined only before this instant.

expired.description: True when the current time has reached expires_at: the offer can then be neither accepted nor declined. Its held seats are released when the expiry is processed, or at once if the waitlist entry is left.

name: university-course-registration.activity.list
description: Read the signed-in student's notices (seat offers, expiries, meeting-time changes, cancelled swaps) and the receipts of every committed write, oldest first. A notice informs; it never accepts an offer or changes an enrollment by itself. Read only.

name: university-course-registration.change.preview
description: Preview one change without making it: enrolling in a bundle, withdrawing from an enrollment, swapping an enrollment for another bundle, or accepting a seat offer. Returns whether it would be allowed now, every rule it fails, the credits and schedule that would result, the time conflicts it would introduce or resolve, and any pending swap it would cancel. Nothing is stored. The returned version is the state the preview was computed from: use it as expected_version for the write, which re-checks everything and is refused if the state has changed. Read only.

action.description: enroll takes section_ids; withdraw takes id; swap takes id and section_ids; accept_offer takes id (the offer).

id.description: The enrollment to withdraw from or to replace, or the offer to accept. Not used for enroll.

section_ids.description: The target bundle for enroll or swap: the lecture section ID, plus one lab section ID when the course requires a lab.

code.description: not_found, invalid_state, offer_not_live, offer_expired, invalid_bundle, withdrawal_closed, registration_closed, swap_required, pending_swap_exists, duplicate_enrollment, prerequisite_missing, seats_available, section_full, credit_limit_exceeded or time_conflict.

offer_id.description: With section_full: the student's own live offer that is holding a seat in one of the full sections. Accept that offer to use the seat.

schedule.description: The schedule after the change: enrollments kept, the bundle added and the enrollment removed.

cancelled_entry_ids.description: Pending swaps that were tied to the enrollment given up and are therefore cancelled.

name: university-course-registration.enrollment.enroll
description: Enroll the signed-in student in one lecture/lab bundle: the lecture section plus one lab section when the course requires a lab. Nothing changes and an error status is returned if the bundle is invalid, registration is closed, the student is already enrolled in the course, a prerequisite is missing, any section is full, the credit limit would be exceeded or a new time conflict would result. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

section_ids.description: The bundle to enroll in: the lecture section ID, plus one lab section ID when the course requires a lab.

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.

enrolled.description: Credits of all currently enrolled courses. Waitlist entries and offers do not count.

limit.description: The student's credit limit for the term.

name: university-course-registration.enrollment.withdraw
description: Withdraw the signed-in student from one of their enrollments. The seats of the whole bundle are released. A pending swap that was waiting to replace this enrollment is cancelled, not turned into an enrollment. Nothing changes and an error status is returned if the enrollment is not held by this student or the withdrawal deadline has passed. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

id.description: The enrollment to withdraw from, as listed by schedule.get.

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.

cancelled_entry_ids.description: Pending swaps that were tied to the enrollment given up and are therefore cancelled.

enrolled.description: Credits of all currently enrolled courses. Waitlist entries and offers do not count.

limit.description: The student's credit limit for the term.

name: university-course-registration.enrollment.swap
description: Replace one of the signed-in student's enrollments with another bundle that is available now, in one step: the new bundle is taken and the old one given up together, or nothing changes. Use it to change sections of the same course or to move to a different course. A seat in a section shared by both bundles is kept, so only the other sections need a free seat. Eligibility is judged on the schedule with the old bundle replaced. On any failure the original enrollment is kept. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

id.description: The enrollment to replace, as listed by schedule.get.

section_ids.description: The bundle to move to: the lecture section ID, plus one lab section ID when the course requires a lab.

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.

replaced_id.description: The enrollment that was given up.

cancelled_entry_ids.description: Pending swaps that were tied to the enrollment given up and are therefore cancelled.

enrolled.description: Credits of all currently enrolled courses. Waitlist entries and offers do not count.

limit.description: The student's credit limit for the term.

name: university-course-registration.waitlist.join
description: Join the waitlist for one lecture/lab bundle that has no seat for the signed-in student right now. Optionally name one of the student's enrollments to swap from: the entry then waits to replace that enrollment, which is kept until the replacement commits. A waitlist entry is not an enrollment and counts toward neither credits nor the timetable. When seats become available, entries are served in the order they joined: an eligible entry receives a time-limited offer, and an entry that fails a rule at that moment keeps its place, holds no seat and shows what blocks it. Joining again for the same bundle returns the existing entry with its rank unchanged. Refused with seats_available when every section the entry would newly occupy has a seat (enroll or swap directly), with swap_required when the student is already enrolled in the course and names no enrollment to swap from, and with pending_swap_exists when that enrollment already has a pending swap. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

section_ids.description: The bundle to wait for: the lecture section ID, plus one lab section ID when the course requires a lab.

swap_from_enrollment_id.description: Optional. One of the student's current enrollments, as listed by schedule.get, that this entry should replace once a seat is offered and accepted. Omit it, or pass null, for an entry that is not a swap.

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.

swap_from_enrollment_id.description: The enrollment this entry would replace, or null for a plain entry.

existing.description: True when the student was already waiting for this bundle: the entry and its rank are unchanged.

rank.description: 1 means no earlier entry is waiting for any of the same seats.

waiting_for_section_ids.description: Sections of the bundle that have no seat for this entry right now.

code.description: not_found, invalid_state, offer_not_live, offer_expired, invalid_bundle, withdrawal_closed, registration_closed, swap_required, pending_swap_exists, duplicate_enrollment, prerequisite_missing, seats_available, section_full, credit_limit_exceeded or time_conflict.

offer_id.description: With section_full: the student's own live offer that is holding a seat in one of the full sections. Accept that offer to use the seat.

blocked_by.description: Rules other than seat availability that this entry fails right now. A blocked entry keeps its place but holds no seat.

name: university-course-registration.waitlist.leave
description: Leave the waitlist: remove one of the signed-in student's waiting entries. A seat offer made to the entry is cancelled and its held seats are released, also when that offer is past its deadline. When the entry was a pending swap, the swap is dropped and the original enrollment is kept unchanged. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

id.description: The waitlist entry to leave, as listed by waitlist.list.

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.

id.description: The waitlist entry that left the queue.

cancelled_offer_id.description: The seat offer that was cancelled with the entry, or null.

name: university-course-registration.offer.accept
description: Accept a seat offer made to one of the signed-in student's waitlist entries. All rules are checked again on the schedule that would result. A plain entry becomes an enrollment; a pending swap gives up its original enrollment and takes the new bundle together. Refused with offer_expired at or after the offer's expires_at, and with offer_not_live when the offer was already accepted, declined, cancelled or expired. On any failure nothing changes: the original enrollment is kept, and an offer that is still live stays held until it is accepted, declined, cancelled or expired. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

id.description: The offer to accept, as listed by waitlist.list (not the waitlist entry).

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.

replaced_id.description: The enrollment given up when the offer fulfilled a pending swap; otherwise null.

enrolled.description: Credits of all currently enrolled courses. Waitlist entries and offers do not count.

limit.description: The student's credit limit for the term.

name: university-course-registration.offer.decline
description: Decline a seat offer made to one of the signed-in student's waitlist entries. The offer is closed, its held seats are released and the entry leaves the queue. An original enrollment the entry would have replaced is kept. Refused with offer_expired at or after the offer's expires_at (the offer is then closed when its expiry is processed; waitlist.leave still releases its seats), and with offer_not_live when the offer was already accepted, declined, cancelled or expired. Pass the version returned by your latest read or preview as expected_version and a new request_id; retrying with the same request_id and arguments is safe.

id.description: The offer to decline, as listed by waitlist.list (not the waitlist entry).

expected_version.description: The version returned by your most recent read or preview of this App. A write based on an older version is refused with stale_version.

request_id.description: A new identifier for this request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request; the original result is then returned and nothing is applied twice.
